# ledger_occurrence_status_override (Data Source)

Reads whether an occurrence has an active manual status override, and what it is. The status Ledger derives from evidence and dates stays separate (`derived_status`); the override is a user correction, not a bank fact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ledger_occurrence_status_override" "march_rent" {
  occurrence_id = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
}

output "march_rent_overridden" {
  value = data.ledger_occurrence_status_override.march_rent.active
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence to read.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether an override is active. When false, status, reason, applied and set_at are null.
- `applied` (Boolean) False for a paid override whose evidence has been removed (no effect); null without an override.
- `derived_status` (String) The payment status derived from evidence and dates alone.
- `payment_status` (String) The occurrence's payment status after any override.
- `reason` (String) Why the status was overridden, or null.
- `set_at` (String) When the override was set (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `status` (String) paid or unpaid, or null.
